More than an abstract elusive concept, mindfulness provides a pragmatic means to interact with our reality, one heartbeat at a time.

The Eightfold Path ensnared this idea—where one witnesses their existence not by the echoes of the past or futures but the gentle thrumming of the moment. This influence remains engraved in layers of mindful psychology and practices, disquieting ancient philosophies. Zazen and Vipassana breathe appreciation for being so rooted in the present that our mere existence takes precedence. Under these beliefs, mindfulness emerged as a mechanism for self-sustenance and devoutness.

Being incorporated into the Western canvas, culture converged with the millennia old philosophy, birthing Western adaptations and tools for self-improvement.
